caption: Alice's four gate choices turn the shared |Φ+⟩ into four different Bell states, one per two-bit message. The top row 00 applies no gate, so Bob receives the original pair unchanged.

spec.title: Encoding table: bits to gate to Bell state
spec.aria: A four-row table mapping the two classical bits 00, 01, 10 and 11 to the gates I, X, Z and XZ and to the resulting Bell states.
